name: Analytic Normal Interpolation for SDF Grids
definition: A method for computing interpolated normals in Signed Distance Function (SDF) grids that differs from standard trilinear interpolation by computing normalized analytic normals at the hit point rather than at voxel corners.
summary: Analytic Normal Interpolation for SDF Grids computes continuous surface normals by evaluating analytic derivatives within a dual voxel framework, ensuring visual smoothness across voxel boundaries.
